import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp")
from harness import *

def one(raw, **kw):
    return run(batch([job(raw=raw, **kw)]))[0]

def w1(raw):
    return one(raw)["wire"].split("\r\n")[1]

def frej(raw):
    return run(batch([job(raw=raw)]))

# ---------------- sip URI ----------------
check("user escape decode", w1(req(frm="SIP:%65mber@STUDIO.TEST.")), "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("user escape upper hex", w1(req(frm="sip:%45mber@studio.test")), "From: <sip:Ember@studio.test>")
check("user case kept", w1(req(frm="sip:Ember@studio.test")), "From: <sip:Ember@studio.test>")
check("user pct25 bad", frej(req(frm="sip:%2561@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("user pct literal bad", frej(req(frm="sip:a%zz@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("user pct short", frej(req(frm="sip:a%4@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("user pct space", frej(req(frm="sip:%20a@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("user pct slash", frej(req(frm="sip:a%2fb@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("user specials ok", w1(req(frm="sip:a-b_c.d!e~f*g'h(i)j+k@studio.test")), "From: <sip:a-b_c.d!e~f*g'h(i)j+k@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("user empty", frej(req(frm="sip:@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("user bad char", frej(req(frm="sip:a,b@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("no at", frej(req(frm="sip:studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("double at", frej(req(frm="sip:a@b@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("port", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test:5060")), [rej("syntax")])
check("uri params", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test;transport=tcp")), [rej("syntax")])
check("password", frej(req(frm="sip:ember:pw@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("query", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test?x=1")), [rej("syntax")])
check("ipv6", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@[::1]")), [rej("syntax")])
check("ipv4 dotted ok", w1(req(frm="sip:ember@1.2.3.4")), "From: <sip:ember@1.2.3.4>;tag=q7")
check("numeric label ok", w1(req(frm="sip:ember@123")), "From: <sip:ember@123>;tag=q7")
check("sips bad", frej(req(frm="sips:ember@studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("host trailing dot", w1(req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test.")), "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("host double dot end", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test..")), [rej("syntax")])
check("host empty label", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@stu..dio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("host leading hyphen", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@-a.studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("host trailing hyphen", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@a-.studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("host hyphen mid ok", w1(req(frm="sip:ember@a-b.studio.test")), "From: <sip:a-b.studio.test".replace("a-b", "ember@a-b") + ";tag=q7")
check("host underscore", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@a_b.studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("host pct", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@%61.studio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("host label 64", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@" + "a"*64 + ".test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("host label 63 ok", one(req(frm="sip:ember@" + "a"*63 + ".test"))["status"], "accept")
check("host 253 ok", one(req(frm="sip:ember@" + "a"*63 + "." + "b"*63 + "." + "c"*63 + "." + "d"*60))["status"], "accept")
check("host 254 bad", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@" + "a"*63 + "." + "b"*63 + "." + "c"*63 + "." + "d"*61)), [rej("syntax")])
check("host 253 with dot ok", one(req(frm="sip:ember@" + "a"*63 + "." + "b"*63 + "." + "c"*63 + "." + "d"*60 + "."))["status"], "accept")
check("uri inner space", frej(req(frm="sip:ember@stu dio.test")), [rej("syntax")])
check("empty uri in brackets", frej(req(frm="<>")), [rej("syntax")])

# ---------------- tel URI ----------------
check("tel alias normalizes", w1(req(frm="TEL:+12025550121")), "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("tel bare", one(req(frm="tel:+12025550122"))["identity"], "sip:desk@sales.test")
check("tel 15 digits", one(req(frm="tel:+123456789012345",))["status"], "reject")
check("tel 16 digits", frej(req(frm="tel:+1234567890123456")), [rej("syntax")])
check("tel leading zero", frej(req(frm="tel:+0123")), [rej("syntax")])
check("tel no plus", frej(req(frm="tel:123456")), [rej("syntax")])
check("tel just plus", frej(req(frm="tel:+")), [rej("syntax")])
check("tel params", frej(req(frm="tel:+12025550121;phone-context=x")), [rej("syntax")])
check("tel visual sep", frej(req(frm="tel:+1-202-555-0121")), [rej("syntax")])
check("tel letters", frej(req(frm="tel:+12a")), [rej("syntax")])
check("tel spaces", frej(req(frm="tel:+12 3")), [rej("syntax")])

# ---------------- reserved anonymous ----------------
check("anon From accept", one(req(frm="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=q7"))["private"], True)
check("anon From case user", frej(req(frm="sip:Anonymous@anonymous.invalid")), [rej("identity")])
check("anon req uri ok", one(req(ruri="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"))["status"], "accept")
check("anon To ok", one(req(to="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"))["status"], "accept")
check("anon PPI syntax", frej(req(extra=("P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>",))), [rej("syntax")])
check("anon PAI syntax", frej(req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>",))), [rej("syntax")])
check("anon RPID syntax", frej(req(extra=("Remote-Party-ID: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>",))), [rej("syntax")])
check("anon From with disp", one(req(frm='"x" <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=q7'))["private"], True)

summary()
